edges.reason: The chiseled red sandstone pillars mark the cave entrance; player must locate them to find and enter the cave
Polished diorite blocks are inside the cave whose entrance is marked by the red sandstone; must find entrance first
Polished diorite is deep in the dark cave; placing torches lets the player visually identify diorite among stone blocks
The jungle button on a log post marks the jungle grove entrance; player must find it to locate the harvestable leaves above
The jungle area contains logs needed for planks and sticks to craft fences; the button marks where to find these resources
Mining leaves clears the canopy to access upper jungle logs and confirms the player is harvesting in the jungle grove
Cooked mutton is stored in a chest directly adjacent to the honey block; finding it reveals the food supply location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The chiseled red sandstone pillars are at (7, 1, 0) relative to spawn (~7 blocks away). max_distance=5 requires the player to walk at least ~2 blocks toward the target, preventing trivial completion from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional visual identification of the landmark.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The honey block is at (0, 0, 12) relative to spawn (12 blocks away). max_distance=5 requires the player to walk at least ~7 blocks south, ensuring genuine navigation. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the honey block when within range.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jungle button on a log post is at (-7, 1, 3) relative to spawn (~7.6 blocks away). max_distance=5 requires the player to walk at least ~2.6 blocks toward the jungle area. facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional identification of the button marker.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='torch') because lighting a cave means placing torch blocks inside it. Checks for 'torch' (floor-placed torches) which is the most natural placement in a flat-floored cave. The cave interior spans from (9,0,-1) to (17,3,2) relative to spawn. min_count=1 means at least one torch placed inside the cave confirms the player has lit it up. Known limitation: wall-placed 'wall_torch' blocks are a separate ID and would not be detected, but floor placement is encouraged by the flat cave geometry.

Uses inventory_has because mining jungle leaves with shears drops the jungle_leaves block item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 jungle_leaves, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining of the canopy with the provided shears.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished diorite with an iron pickaxe drops the polished_diorite item into inventory. The diorite blocks are embedded in cave walls deep inside (at ~15-17, y=1-2), flush with surrounding stone, requiring torch light to visually distinguish. Player starts with 0 polished_diorite, so having at least 1 confirms successful identification and mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle fence at the crafting table produces fence items in the player's inventory. Recipe: 2 jungle planks + 4 sticks = 3 jungle fences. Player obtains materials by chopping jungle logs with iron axe, then crafting planks and sticks. Player starts with 0 jungle_fence, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the player must retrieve cooked mutton from the chest adjacent to the honey block (chest contains 5). Having at least 1 cooked_mutton in inventory confirms the player found and opened the chest, completing the find→retrieve chain. Note: 'use_item' is not a valid rule type, so inventory pickup serves as the best available proxy for the eat task. The prerequisite dependency on find_honey_block ensures this requires proper navigation.

task_text: Explore this outpost area. Find the chiseled red sandstone pillars marking a cave entrance, then light up the dark cave with torches to identify and mine the polished diorite hidden among the stone walls. Find the jungle button marking a jungle grove, mine the jungle leaves to clear the canopy, harvest logs to craft a fence. Find the honey block to locate the chest with cooked mutton and eat it.
